thread:
amanda_sales: Hey team — Atlas Retail POC goes live Mon. They sent a security questionnaire and expect validated throughput numbers + preheat/autoscale plan. Also asking for reserved GPU pricing delta vs on-demand. Can SRE/Eng/Finance help? 

mike_eng: Can you paste the traffic profile we should size for?

amanda_sales: Quick excerpt from their doc:
- steady 250 req/s for generate endpoints
- median ~4k tokens/request (incl. context)
- promo bursts up to 800 req/s for ~5–15m, ~2x/day
- p95 latency SLO 200ms
- embeddings ~20 req/s
Link: https://drive.company/atlas-poc/traffic-profile (internal)

jin_prod: Ack. Rough calc: 250 * 4000 = 1,000,000 tokens/s baseline. With our batching and prefix cache we can drop token work by ~30–50% for common prompts. For worst-case cold runs plan for full tokens.

sarah_sre: For reserved GPUs: for sustained 250 req/s at 4k tok we should reserve 3 x rGPU (NVIDIA A100 class) as a starting point with autoscale to 5 on bursts. That gives headroom for 800 req/s bursts with autoscale cooldown.

mike_eng: Proposed autoscale policy (draft):
```
policy:
  metric: requests_per_sec
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75 * reserved_capacity
  scale_down_threshold: 0.40 * reserved_capacity
  cooldown_up: 60s
  cooldown_down: 300s
  prewarm_on_burst: true
```
Notes: use prefix/KV cache pre-warm and warm-up nodes for 30s before traffic cuts over.

amanda_sales: That sounds reasonable. Any pricing delta estimate for reserved vs on-demand?

leo_fin: Quick ballpark: reserving 3 rGPUs -> ~35% discount vs on-demand sustained. Autoscale to 5 will incur some on-demand during bursts; estimate blended cost ~25% savings overall depending on burst fraction. I'll attach a simple model later.

sarah_sre: Security questionnaire blockers: they want KMS integration for encryption-at-rest and monthly key rotation proof. We have KMS + HSM options, need to confirm the on-prem private deployment flow if they demand customer-managed keys. @amanda_sales can you surface that question to their SecOps?

amanda_sales: Yep will ask. Also they flagged network egress logs and audit retention (1y). Is that feasible?

jin_prod: We store audit logs for 13 months in enterprise plan, configurable. For egress, we can provide flow logs to their SIEM via S3 forwarder. No blocker.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled preheat run window Mon 03:00–04:00 UTC for Atlas POC — CI job kickoff when SRE confirms.

sarah_sre: Action items:
- @jin_prod: finalize capacity calc and change to 4 reserved if token variance >10% by EOD Thu
- @leo_fin: pricing model + blended cost by Fri
- @amanda_sales: ask SecOps clarifying Qs (KMS customer-managed, egress logs retention)
- @mike_eng: draft preheat script to populate KV caches and run 5m synthetic at 600 req/s

amanda_sales: Thanks — tagging Atlas point: @atlas-poc (if they have questions). Will update once SecOps replies. :thumbsup:
